title: Schnell fiber spaces and good canonical models
main_claim: For an algebraic fiber space f: X->Y of smooth projective varieties with kappa(F)=0, if m0K_X - f^*H is psef for an ample H, then kappa(X)=dim Y. The paper also derives the Campana–Peternell inequality kappa(X)>=kappa(D) when m0K_X-D is psef, and Schnell's general conclusion kappa(X)=kappa(F)+dim Y with sections of l r K_X - f^*H. All of this assumes the existence of good minimal models, taken from the companion LogAbundance2026, Cor. 11.2.

issues.location: Section 3, Theorem 3.1 (quoting LogAbundance2026 Cor. 11.2); used in the proofs of Thm 1.1 and both corollaries
issues.description: Every result is conditional on a companion paper. That paper claims a good klt minimal model, with semiample K_V, for every smooth projective X whose K_X is pseudo-effective. This is the full minimal model plus abundance conjecture for smooth varieties, which is open. The canonical nonvanishing used in Schnell's reduction rests on the same input. The geometric argument in this paper is a standard and sound reduction to that input.
issues.evidence: Section 3: 'The following theorem is [LogAbundance2026, Corollary 11.2]; its proof belongs to that companion article.' The sibling audit of Log-abundance (rank235) was only partial-depth.

coverage: Read all four sections in full; together they are the whole proof (about 800 lines). Checked: Lemma 2.2, the easy-addition upper bound via the generic fibre and transcendence degree. Lemma 2.3, the mixed test class C=(q*D)^k (q*A)^{d-k-1}: it pairs nonnegatively with every psef class; the projection formula gives E.C=0 for q-exceptional E; (q*D)^{k+1}=0 because the image has dimension k; h*H.C>0 via a transverse point when y>k, using a rank argument and a perturbation/density argument. The section injection H^0(V,rK_V)->H^0(X,rK_X) via the effective rE, with p_*O_W=O_X. The final contradiction p*K_X.C=0 against psef m0 p*K_X - h*H. The reduction of very general fibres to the geometric generic fibre, and psef restriction. The Campana–Peternell iteration, including the linear equivalence (a_i b_i + r_i)K - L_i ~ b_i(a_i K - f*H_i) and the strictly increasing dim Y_i. The general corollary via the Fujita–Mori criterion (Popa–Schnell Lemma 4.6) plus twisting a big B to the ample H. Not checked: the cited reductions in Schnell 2022, Secs 4–9, and the companion LogAbundance proof.
sibling_notes: Same family as Log-abundance-in-characteristic-zero (rank235, no_gap_found, partial-depth audit). This paper is a thin, sound wrapper around its Cor. 11.2. Zou 2025 proves Theorem 1.1 independently without the companion paper, so the main theorem is not new, but the conditional proof given here is correct.
